battleTraits.name: FORM UP!
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders.
• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Cannonade Cogfort’.

battleTraits.name: TAKE AIM!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: Pick 1 of that unit’s ranged weapons. Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made with that weapon for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: SOUND THE ATTACK!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a CHARGE ability for a unit that is under orders
battleTraits.effect:
Used By: The unit using that CHARGE ability.
You can change the lowest D6 in the charge roll to match the highest D6.

battleTraits.name: INTO THEM, YOU DOGS!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly HERO that is under orders to use this ability. That unit is the field officer for the rest of the turn. Then, pick 2 other visible friendly non-HERO units that are under orders and wholly within 12" of the field officer to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, the first time the field officer uses a FIGHT ability, you can pick a target that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn. That target is inspirited and the other target is emboldened. The inspirited target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by the field officer has been resolved. Then, if the emboldened target has not used a FIGHT ability this turn, it can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the inspirited target’s FIGHT ability has been resolved.

battleTraits.name: HURL THEM BACK!
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unit that is under orders and in combat with an enemy unit that charged this turn to use this ability.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of that unit’s melee weapons.

battleTraits.name: FORM UP, ALLIES!
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES unit to use this ability, then pick 2 other visible friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders.
• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Freeguild Cavalier-Marshal’ or ‘Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard’.

battleTraits.name: FORCES OF ORDER
battleTraits.effect:
While 3 friendly ALLIES OF THE FREE CITIES units are wholly within 12" of each other and 1 of those units has the AELF keyword, 1 of those units has the DUARDIN keyword and 1 of those units has the SIGMARITE keyword:
• Those units have WARD (5+) against shooting attacks.
• Add 3 to those units’ control scores.
• Add 1 to wound rolls for those units’ combat attacks.

battleTraits.name: DUARDRAZHAL
battleTraits.effect: Friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units are unified while they are wholly within 12" of at least 1 FYRESLAYERS, 1 KHARADRON OVERLORDS and 1 CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit.

battleTraits.name: 'AS THE ANCESTORS INTENDED!'
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: 'PAH! NOW THIS IS A SHOT...'
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s ranged weapons for the rest of the turn .

battleTraits.name: 'AS ONE, KINFOLK!'
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Charge Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY units to be the targets.
battleTraits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

battleTraits.name: 'SETTLE EVERY GRUDGE! KHAZUK!'
battleTraits.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Comhat Phase
battleTraits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.
battleTraits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

battleTraits.name: FORM UP, IRON MARCH!
battleTraits.declare:
Pick a friendly IRON MARCH unit to use this ability, then pick either 1 or 2 other visible friendly IRON MARCH units wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
The unit using this ability and the targets:
• cannot be under orders.
• must each be a different unit type.
battleTraits.effect:
For the rest of the battle round, the unit using this ability and the targets are under orders.
Designer’s Note: ‘Unit type’ refers to the name of the warscroll (Core Rules, 4.0), e.g. ‘Cannonade Cogfort’ or ‘Mallus Forgepriest’.

abilities.name: TO THE LAST
abilities.effect: Each time a friendly unit that is under orders uses the ‘Rally’ command, you can make 3 additional rally rolls of D6.

abilities.name: MASTERS OF THE ARCANE
abilities.effect:
Add 1 to arcane manipulation rolls and banishment rolls for friendly WIZARDS that are under orders.
Designer’s Note: WIZARDS in this battletome use arcane manipulation rolls for a variety of powerful effects.

abilities.name: THRONGS OF THE FAITHFUL
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: Your opponent declared a FIGHT ability
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly SIGMARITE units that target the enemy unit using that FIGHT ability.

abilities.name: DAWNBRINGER CRUSADE
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR INFANTRY unit wholly within friendly territory to use this ability.
abilities.effect:
If that unit is in combat, it can move 6". It can move through the combat ranges of enemy units but can only end that move in combat with units it was in combat with at the start of that move. It does not have to end the move in combat.
If that unit is not in combat, it can move 6". It cannot move into combat during any part of that move.

abilities.name: CANNY CREWS
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilities.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly Ironweld Great Cannon units to be the targets.
abilities.effect: For the rest of the turn, each time the target uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll, or 1 wound roll, or 1 random characteristic roll for the Damage characteristic.

abilities.name: FRONT-LINE LEADER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilities.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR HUMAN INFANTRY HERO to use this ability. Then, you can pick up to 1 friendly NON-HERO HUMAN INFANTRY unit and up to 1 friendly HUMAN WAR MACHINE unit that are wholly within 12" of that HERO to be the targets.
abilities.effect: While the targets are wholly within 12" of that HERO, add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target INFANTRY unit’s melee weapons and the target WAR MACHINE unit’s ranged weapons until the start of your next turn.

abilities.name: HAVE NO MERCY
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Start of Battle Round
abilities.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit to be the target.
abilities.effect: Until the start of the next battle round, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF units that target that enemy unit while it is damaged or has had any models slain in the same turn.

abilities.name: I’VE SEEN WORSE AND KILLED BETTER
abilities.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Enemy Combat Phase
abilities.declare: Pick an enemy unit that charged this turn and is in combat with any friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that did not charge this turn to be the target.
abilities.effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, other than the Companion weapon ability, weapon abilities for the target’s combat attacks have no effect for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: SPEED OF THE TWIN-TAILED COMET
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 3" to the Move characteristic of friendly non-WAR MACHINE CITIES OF SIGMAR units while they are wholly within 12" of the caster and visible to them.

entries.name: CURSE OF SCORCHED METAL
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, the first time the target uses an ATTACK ability, for each unmodified hit roll of 1 for an attack made by the target as part of that ATTACK ability, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target after the ATTACK ability has been resolved.

entries.name: HIGH STAR’S LIGHT
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: HOLY AEGIS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 7+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each target in each phase.

entries.name: RECKONING OF SINNERS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: If the chanting roll was 10+, you can pick another eligible unit to be a second target. Until the start of your next turn, enemy units have a maximum control score of 1 while they are in combat with any of the targets.

entries.name: BENEDICTION OF THE HIGH HEAVENS
entries.declare: Pick a friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick another visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Heal (D3) the target and the chanter. If the chanting roll was 7+, Heal (D3) each visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of the chanter instead.

entries.name: Alchemite Warforger

abilityDetails.name: Runic Crucible
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly SIGMARITE unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, the target’s melee weapons have Crit (Mortal) until the start of your next turn.

entries.flavour: The specialist wizards known as Alchemite Warforgers wield the raw energies of Chamon. They can change the properties of not only metal but reality itself. As muscular and sweaty as blacksmiths, these mages pluck glowing runecubes from their crucibles, channelling metallurgic magic to destroy their foes.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Thaumaturgical Specialist.

entries.name: Allies of the Free Cities Auric Hearthguard

abilityDetails.name: Lava-Encrusted
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is under orders, each time a shooting attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, subtract 1" from the target unit’s Move characteristic until the start of your next turn (this effect is cumulative). This ability cannot reduce the target unit’s Move characteristic below half its starting value.

entries.flavour: Auric Hearthguard are the trusted custodians of a Fyreslayer lodge’s magma-vault. Armed with lava-spewing pikes, they have been known to fight alongside humans of Sigmar’s cities, reasoning that offensive action with allied support is the best way to safeguard their lodge’s precious ur-gold.
entries.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

entries.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Sentinels

abilityDetails.name: Fire Lofted Shots!
abilityDetails.timing: Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit is under orders, for the rest of the turn:
• Add 6" to the Range characteristic of this unit’s Auralan Bows.
• Subtract 1 from hit rolls for this unit’s shooting attacks.

entries.flavour: Auralan Sentinels are supreme marksman with their mighty longbows, capable of sending an arrow through an enemy’s eye at a hundred paces. Their arched trajectories perfectly supplement the headlong firepower of a Castelite formation, raining down death amongst the foe.
entries.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

entries.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vanari Auralan Wardens

abilityDetails.name: Protective Pike-Wall
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is under orders and has not charged this turn, ignore the effect of the Charge (+1 Damage) ability for combat attacks made by enemy units that target this unit.

entries.flavour: Auralan Wardens form the glittering spine of the Lumineth Realm-lords’ martial hosts. Armed with long pikes to engage the enemy at a distance, they fight with perfect precision and skill. They might find the human way of war cumbersome and inefficient, but they see the God-King’s folk as key allies in their campaigns against the Dark Gods.
entries.notes: This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.

entries.name: Allies of the Free Cities Vulkyn Flameseekers

abilityDetails.name: Allied Drothmasters
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy MONSTER in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: If this unit is under orders, apply the effect below. Otherwise, roll a dice. On a 3+, apply the effect below.
Subtract 2 from the Damage characteristic of the target’s Companion melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Vulkyn Flameseekers are strange duardin who roam the realms in search of Magmadroth eggs – a precious resource that holds both spiritual and practical significance in Fyreslayer society. Accompanied by hunting beasts and wielding a variety of deadly weaponry, they sometimes join Sigmarite crusades heading into enemy- held territories.
entries.notes:
This unit cannot be reinforced.
This unit can only be taken in an Allies of the Free Cities Army of Renown.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Vulkyn Weapons.
• 1/9 models is a Kyndledroth and must replace their weapons with Kyndledroth’s Fangs.
• The champion is a Vulkyn Runefather and cannot replace their weapons.

entries.name: Amethyst Knellmage

abilityDetails.name: Deathly Candlelight
abilityDetails.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: The target cannot use commands for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Ominous Presence
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Deathly Candlelight’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

entries.flavour: Strange and unnerving are the Amethyst Knellmages, masters of Shyishan magic. Their bizarre, bell-shaped helms are topped by hammer-wielding skeletal figures that toll a percussive rhythm; the wizards swing their deadly scythes in time to each soul-shaking peal.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Thaumaturgical Specialist.

entries.name: Aqshian Pyrocaster

abilityDetails.name: Incandescent Incineration
abilityDetails.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
Effect: If the target was not incandescent when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
• The target is incandescent for the rest of the battle.
If the target was incandescent when they were picked to be the target of this spell:
• Allocate 3 damage points to the target (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points).
• The target is no longer incandescent.

abilityDetails.name: The Flames of Aqshy
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Make an arcane manipulation roll of D6. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, when picking a target for the ‘Incandescent Incineration’ ability, you can pick a visible enemy unit within 18" of this unit instead of within 12".

entries.flavour: Battlemages who dedicate themselves to the Aqshian school of magic are fiery and aggressive souls. Known as Pyrocasters, they channel the tremendous power of bright magic through their emberstone wands, annihilating their foes in an explosion of flame.
entries.notes: This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Thaumaturgical Specialist.

entries.name: Assassin

abilityDetails.name: In For The Kill
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: This unit has STRIKE-FIRST if it charged in the same turn.

abilityDetails.name: Hidden Murderer
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit is within the combat range of a friendly INFANTRY unit that has 5 or more models and there are no enemy units within this unit’s combat range, this unit is not visible to enemy units.

entries.flavour: T here is no fortress, city or fortified war camp that the feared Shadowblade Assassins cannot infiltrate, and few foes can hope to survive the potent poisons delivered by their wicked daggers.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Battlemage

abilityDetails.name: Protective Focus
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a SPELL ability that this unit can use. For the rest of the battle, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit if it miscasts that spell.

entries.flavour: Masters of the arcane arts, the grizzled Battlemages of the Collegiate Arcane summon lethal storms of magic to lay waste to their foes and shield their comrades from harm with protective enchantment.
entries.notes:
This HERO can join an eligible regiment as a Thaumaturgical Specialist.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Battlemage on Celestial Hurricanum

abilityDetails.name: Portents of Battle
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for the target’s combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

abilityDetails.name: Storm of Shemtek
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Shooting Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Make a number of D3 rolls equal to the current battle round number. For each 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.flavour: Celestial Battlemages harness the cosmic power of High Azyr to bring down storms and send arcs of lightning cascading through the ranks of the enemy, unleashing raw elemental power that is terrible to witness.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027. 120 x 92mm

entries.name: Battlemage on Griffon

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of its Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks is 4.

abilityDetails.name: Ghurish Ferocity
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Roll a dice. On a 2+, add 1 to the Damage characteristic of this unit’s Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks for attacks that target enemy MONSTERS for the rest of the turn.

melee: Griffon’s Razor Claws and Twin Beaks

entries.flavour: When mounted atop a furious, twin-headed Ghurish griffon, a Battlemage of the Amber College can lay waste to their foes from afar or strike from on high in a vicious frenzy of stabbing beaks and ripping talons.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027. 120 x 92mm

entries.name: Battlemage on Luminark of Hysh

abilityDetails.name: Aura of Protection
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick a visible friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR unit wholly within 12" of this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, until the start of your next turn, the target has WARD (6+) while it is wholly within 12" of and visible to this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Searing Beam of Light
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time this unit attacks with its Searing Beam of Light, pick a point on the battlefield within range to be the target. If the attack scores a hit, draw a straight line between that point and the closest point on this unit’s base. Inflict D3 mortal damage on each visible unit (friendly and enemy) that the line passes across.

entries.flavour: Powerful Light Wizards from the upper echelons of the Collegiate Arcane sometimes ride to war upon a Luminark of Hysh, directing its searing beam of light to vaporise the direst threats of the enemy whilst deftly casting scouring sorceries of their own.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027. 120 x 92mm

entries.name: Black Ark Corsairs

abilityDetails.name: Swift Shots
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: If this unit is in combat, it can immediately use the ‘Shoot’ ability as if it were your shooting phase. All attacks must target the same enemy unit, and the enemy unit picked to be the target of the attacks must be in combat with this unit and have charged this phase.

entries.flavour: Cruel-hearted and avaricious, Black Ark Corsairs are the footsoldiers of the Scourge Privateers. Wielding a variety of lethal weapons, they thrive in the chaos of a swirling melee, where their superior swordsmanship can be put to deadly use.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Black Ark Fleetmaster

abilityDetails.name: ’At Them, You Curs!’
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly Black Ark Corsairs unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved. If it is picked to do so, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target’s melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.flavour: Fleetmasters are rulers of the high seas, Corsair lords who command the marauding Black Arks of the Scourge Privateers. Peerless swordfighters, they delight in seeking out worthy foes against whom to test their skill.
entries.notes:
This Hero can join a Dreadlord on Black Dragon’s, Sorceress’ or Sorceress on Black Dragon’s regiment.
This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Black Guard

abilityDetails.name: Steel and Sorcery
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While any friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR AELF INFANTRY HEROES are wholly within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and those friendly units have WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: These fanatical warriors guard the rulers of the Darkling Covens. Armed with ebon halberds and clad in ensorcelled plate, they present an impassable and deadly obstacle to any who threaten their wards.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Bleakswords

abilityDetails.name: Merciless Conquerors
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons while it is contesting an objective you do not control.

entries.flavour: Bleakswords leap into the fray in a blur of flashing steel. Wielding their duelling swords with unnatural grace, they slice their foes to ribbons with an unstoppable flurry of strikes.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Brethren of the Bolt

abilityDetails.name: Crackling with Faith
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a combat attack made by this unit scores a critical hit, you can pick an enemy unit within 6" of this unit that was not the target of that combat attack. Inflict 1 mortal damage on that enemy unit after the FIGHT ability has been resolved.

abilityDetails.name: Pater Filius
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit’s Pater Filius is on the battlefield, it has PRIEST (1).

abilityDetails.name: Bolt From the Blue
abilityDetails.timing: Your Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: You can pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target. Then, make a chanting roll of D6.
Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn. If a target was picked, inflict D3 mortal damage on the target. If the chanting roll was 10+, inflict 3 mortal damage on the target instead.

entries.flavour: Armed with a relic that once belonged to a Stormcast Eternal and held aloft by his adopted son to bring him closer to Azyr, Pater Filius leads the Brethren of the Bolt with shocking zeal. The Brethren of the Bolt worship Sigmar in his aspect as a bringer of divine lightning, and they channel electrical charge from the air into their weapons. Each carries a crude disc of hammered copper in order to better guide lightning towards them.
entries.notes: This unit cannot be reinforced.
entries.description:
Each model in this unit is armed with Brethren Weapons. The models in this unit are:
• Pater Filius (champion)
• Friar Galvic
• Soror Tazat
• Acolyte Arcus
• Scorched Yakob

entries.name: Callis and Toll

abilityDetails.name: Relentless Hunters
abilityDetails.timing: Start of Battle Round
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: This unit can use this ability even if it is in the shadows. If there is no enemy mark, pick an enemy HERO on the battlefield to be the target. If there are no enemy HEROES on the battlefield, pick an enemy non-HERO unit on the battlefield to be the target instead.
Effect: The target is the mark for the rest of the battle.

abilityDetails.name: Right Tools For The Job
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Double the Damage characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons for attacks that target the enemy mark.

entries.flavour: Deadly with sword and pistol, Hanniver Toll is a veteran hunter of witches, fiends, monsters and insurrectionists. Backed up by the two-fisted firepower of ex-Freeguild soldier Armand Callis, he wages a ceaseless war against the enemies of Sigmar.

entries.name: Cannonade Cogfort

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points:
• The Attacks characteristic of its Crushing Iron Feet is 3.
• It has a Control characteristic of 5.

abilityDetails.name: Full Power!
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: Pick 1 or more of the following effects. For each effect you pick, give this unit a number of heat tokens equal to the number beside it.
1 Launch Countermeasures!: Until the start of your next turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target other friendly SIGMARITE units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit and are under orders.
2 Full Throttle!: For the rest of the turn, this unit’s Move characteristic is 10".
3 Calculate Firing Solution!: For the rest of the turn, each time this unit uses a SHOOT ability, you can re-roll 1 hit roll and 1 wound roll for shooting attacks made with this unit’s Godbreaker Cannon.
6 Get Us Out of Here!: For the rest of the turn,

abilityDetails.name: Overheating
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Immediately after resolving this unit’s ‘Full Power!’ ability, you must roll a number of dice equal to the number of heat tokens this unit has. For each 5+, allocate 1 damage point to this unit (ward rolls cannot be made for those damage points), then remove 1 of this unit’s heat tokens.

abilityDetails.name: Special Ammunition
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Reaction: You declared a SHOOT ability for this unit
abilityDetails.effect:
Effect: If this unit is under orders, roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the following effects.
Nullshot: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for damage points inflicted by attacks made with this unit’s Godbreaker Cannon this phase.

Though mere mortals in a world filled with walking nightmares, Hexbane’s Hunters burn with conviction and bring with them the full might of humanity’s determination and resourcefulness – let the enemies of Sigmar beware!

entries.flavour: At the forefront of larger Steam Tank formations ride the Steam Tank Commanders, veterans of countless battles who are deft at coordinating shock assaults that leave the enemy shattered and reeling.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Tahlia Vedra, Lioness of the Parch

abilityDetails.name: Battle Damaged
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While this unit has 10 or more damage points, the Attacks characteristic of Infernadine’s Leonine Jaws is 2.

abilityDetails.name: Lead From The Front
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle, Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is in combat, pick each visible friendly SIGMARITE unit wholly within 12" of it to be the targets.
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for the targets’ combat attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Paralysing Venom
abilityDetails.timing: Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is equal to or less than the target’s Health characteristic, subtract 1 from wound rolls for the target’s attacks for the rest of the turn.

abilityDetails.name: Combat Tactician
abilityDetails.timing: Enemy Hero Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick a visible friendly SIGMARITE INFANTRY unit wholly within 18" of it and that is not in combat to be the target.
Effect: The target can immediately use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase. In addition, the target is under orders for the rest of the battle round.

melee: Anti-MONSTER (+1 Rend), Companion · See battle damage rules

entries.flavour: Named the Lioness of the Parch by her loyal soldiers, Tahlia Vedra has risen through the ranks of the Freeguilds and emerged as the foremost tactical mind of Hammerhal Aqsha. Now it is she who leads the city in its quest to reclaim Aqshy’s hearthlands from the grip of Chaos.

entries.name: Toll’s Companions

abilityDetails.name: Hidden Agents
abilityDetails.timing: Deployment Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and a friendly Callis and Toll unit if those units have not been deployed.
Effect: Set up those units in reserve in the shadows. They have now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Emerge from the Shadows
abilityDetails.timing: Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is in the shadows.
Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units. Then, set up the friendly Callis and Toll unit in the shadows wholly within 6" of this unit, more than 6" from the enemy mark and more than 9" from all other enemy units.

abilityDetails.name: Saviours of Cinderfall
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: While a friendly Callis and Toll unit is within this unit’s combat range, both this unit and that friendly unit have WARD (5+).

entries.flavour: Hanniver Toll has assembled a rogue’s gallery to aid him in his quest to purify the God-King’s cities. The master thief Lyssa Revenya and the information broker Mistress Verentia are as cunning as they are deadly, while Valius, Keeper Aqshian of Hammerhal, brings his celestial strength to the cause.
entries.notes: This unit can only be taken in Callis and Toll’s regiment.

entries.name: War Hydra

abilityDetails.name: Impossible to Destroy
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), End of Any Turn
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Heal (6) this unit.

abilityDetails.name: Six-headed Strike
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll 6 dice. For each 3+, inflict 1 mortal damage on the target.

entries.flavour: Greatest of all the abominations spawned by the experiments of the Order Serpentis are the monstrosities known as War Hydras, each one created through dark sorcery and perfectly tailored for the battlefield. Driven forward by the lashes of scarred handlers, these creatures are imprecise but devastating living weapons.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Warden King

abilityDetails.name: Ancestral Grudgebearer
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Battle (Army), Deployment Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in your opponent’s army to bear a grudge against. You can pick an enemy unit that is in reserve.
Effect: For the rest of the battle, add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN units that target that unit.

abilityDetails.name: Fearless Leader
abilityDetails.timing: Reaction: You declared a %000010870FIGHT ability% for this unit
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Pick a friendly non-HERO CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit that has not used a FIGHT ability this turn and is within this unit’s combat range to be the target. The target can be picked to use a FIGHT ability immediately after the FIGHT ability used by this unit has been resolved.

entries.flavour: Warden Kings are the leaders of the Dispossessed duardin, venerable fighters and strategists who seek out the most fearsome enemy combatants and bludgeon them to death with rune-carved warhammers.
entries.notes: This unit will move to Warhammer Legends on 1 June 2027.

entries.name: Wildercorps Hunters

abilityDetails.name: Expert Pathfinders
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Deployment Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit and up to 2 friendly non-MONSTER non-WAR MACHINE SIGMARITE units if none of them have been deployed.
Effect: Set up those units in reserve scouting ahead. They have now been deployed.

abilityDetails.name: Prepared Arrival
abilityDetails.timing: Once Per Turn (Army), Your Movement Phase
abilityDetails.effect:
Declare: Pick this unit if it is scouting ahead.
Effect: Set up this unit on the battlefield wholly within 9" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units. Then, set up each other friendly unit scouting ahead wholly within 12" of this unit and more than 9" from all enemy units.

entries.flavour: Trackers, scouts and outdoorsmen, the Wildercorps are experts in attacking from the cover of thick foliage and broken ground. Their hounds surge forward, sinking fangs into flesh even as skilled marksmen pick out their targets with crossbows.
entries.description:
• The champion is a Wildercorps Warden and is armed with a Hunting Crossbow, Wildercorps Hunting Weapons and a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite.
• 6/11 models in this unit are Wildercorpsmen and are armed with a Hunting Crossbow and Wildercorps Hunting Weapons.
• 4/11 models are Trailhounds and are armed with a Trailhound’s Ferocious Bite.

entries.name: Wisper

abilityDetails.name: Spiritual Locus
abilityDetails.timing: Passive
abilityDetails.effect: Effect: Each time a friendly Jacobus Vyne uses a SPELL or SHOOT ability, you can measure range and visibility from this MANIFESTATION instead of from that friendly unit.

entries.flavour: A connection to the primal essence of Aquia, the vulpine forest spirit Wisper is a swift and sharp‑fanged creature through which Jacobus Vyne can channel his most powerful incantations.
